idea_angle: Day 1 of a realistic no-spend January: not zero spending, just zero unplanned spending. The plan, the example math ($400 of extras down to $100, $300 kept), and rule 1: write the allowed list.

script.title: No-spend January, day 1: the realistic version
script.hook: No-spend January doesn't mean spending $0. Here's the realistic version in 4 rules, starting today.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: No-spend January doesn't mean spending zero dollars. Here's the realistic version, in four rules, starting today.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a calendar page for January with a small jar. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The idea
segments.narration: Bills, rent, groceries and gas still get paid. The no-spend part is everything unplanned: takeout on a whim, shopping apps, the random stuff that disappears from your account.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two piles, one with a tick and one with a pause sign. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The math
segments.narration: Example: someone spends about four hundred a month on unplanned extras. Keep a twenty-five dollar treat each week, so a hundred for the month, and three hundred stays in savings. Your numbers will be different.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a coin stack shrinking from four to one. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The plan
segments.narration: One rule every Sunday. Today: the allowed list. Next week: one planned treat. Then: friction. Then: the slip rule. And on January thirty-first, the tally.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. four small boxes and a flag. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Rule 1
segments.narration: Rule one: write your allowed list now. Rent, bills, groceries, gas, medicine, and anything already committed, like a gym or a birthday. If it's not on the list, it waits until February.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a short list on a fridge. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Committed costs
segments.narration: Already booked a concert or a friend's birthday dinner in January? Put it on the allowed list now, with a number, so it doesn't feel like breaking the rules later.
segments.on_screen_text: Booked plans go on the list
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a ticket pinned to a calendar. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Tonight
segments.narration: Stick the list somewhere you'll see it, like your phone's lock screen or the fridge. And open a savings bucket named January, so next Sunday's money has somewhere to go.
segments.on_screen_text: List on the lock screen · open a bucket
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a phone lock screen with a short list. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.hook: Week 2 of a realistic no-spend January. Rule 2: 1 planned treat a week, on purpose.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Week two of a realistic no-spend January. Rule two: one planned treat a week, on purpose.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a coffee cup with a small star. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: New here?
segments.narration: Just found us? This is a no-spend January with one new rule each Sunday. Week one's video is pinned, but this rule works on its own.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pinned note on a board. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Why a treat
segments.narration: Total bans feel strong on day one and break around day nine. A small treat you've planned takes the pressure off, so the whole month doesn't collapse over one coffee.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a rubber band stretching but not snapping. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Pick it
segments.narration: Pick this week's treat now, with a number: a coffee date, a movie, a takeout night. Our example: twenty-five dollars. Put the day in your calendar.
segments.on_screen_text: Pick it · price it: $25 · schedule it
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with one starred day. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The transfer
segments.narration: Then the Sunday move. In our example, a normal week has about a hundred dollars of extras. This week it was the twenty-five dollar treat, so seventy-five moves into the January bucket.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a coin moving into a jar labelled January. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Together
segments.narration: Living with someone? Agree on the treat together, so one of you isn't doing no-spend January while the other orders takeout. A shared treat, like a cheap movie night at home, often works best for both.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two people sharing a bowl of popcorn. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Count it
segments.narration: If you didn't track exactly, estimate. The point is that the money moves, so the win is visible every week.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pencil next to a small number. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.title: No-spend January, week 3: add friction, not willpower
script.hook: Week 3 of a realistic no-spend January. Rule 3: 3 bits of friction that beat willpower.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Week three of a realistic no-spend January. Rule three: three bits of friction that beat willpower.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a shopping cart behind a small gate. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: New here?
segments.narration: First time here? Every Sunday this month adds one realistic rule. Catch up from the pinned video, or start with this one today.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pinned note on a board. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Friction 1
segments.narration: One: delete saved cards from shopping apps and your browser. Typing sixteen digits gives you a few seconds to change your mind.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a phone with a card and an X. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Friction 2
segments.narration: Two: unsubscribe from five store emails and turn off shopping app notifications. Fewer sale alerts, fewer carts.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. an envelope with a small X. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Friction 3
segments.narration: Three: keep a February list. When you want something, write it down instead of buying it. In February, check the list. Many things won't feel urgent anymore.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a notepad titled February. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Free swaps
segments.narration: Replace the spending habit with a free one. Bored scrolling on a shopping app? Swap it for a library app, a walk or a call with a friend. It works better than simply trying to stop, because the habit has something to go to.
segments.on_screen_text: Swap the habit for a free one
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a phone switching from a cart to a book. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Social plans
segments.narration: Invited out? Suggest the cheaper version: coffee instead of dinner, a walk instead of drinks, or a potluck at someone's place. Most friends are happy to say yes, especially in January.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two coffee cups on a park bench. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The transfer
segments.narration: Sunday move, same as last week. Example: seventy-five dollars, so the January bucket is at one hundred fifty. Halfway there in our example plan.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a jar half full. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.title: No-spend January, week 4: the slip rule
script.hook: Week 4 of a realistic no-spend January. Rule 4: what to do when you slip, because almost everyone does.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Week four of a realistic no-spend January. Rule four: what to do when you slip, because almost everyone does.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a small banana peel next to a path that keeps going. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: New here?
segments.narration: Joining late? There's still a week left. The first rule is pinned, and this one makes sense even if it's your first.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pinned note on a board. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The myth
segments.narration: Myth: one slip means the challenge is over, so you might as well spend. Fact: one forty-dollar slip in a month you saved three hundred is still a great month.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a scale with a small coin and a big jar. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The rule
segments.narration: The slip rule: write it down, subtract it from this Sunday's transfer, and carry on tomorrow. No restarting from zero, and no making up for it with a punishment week.
segments.on_screen_text: Log it · subtract it · keep going
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a notebook with one line crossed out. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Spot why
segments.narration: Then ask what caused it. Tired, bored, an app notification, a friend's plan? Fix that one trigger for next week, like leaving the card at home on Friday nights.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a magnifying glass over a small bell. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Big slips
segments.narration: Big slip, like a hundred-dollar order? Check if it can be returned. If it can't, still log it and keep going. The month is still worth finishing.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a box with a return arrow. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The transfer
segments.narration: Example: a normal week of extras is a hundred. This week had the twenty-five dollar treat. So seventy-five moves again, and the bucket is at two twenty-five.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a jar three-quarters full. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: New here?
segments.narration: New here? This was a four-rule, four-Sunday plan. Day one is pinned. You can run it in any month, like a no-spend March.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pinned note and a calendar. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The tally
segments.narration: The example plan: seventy-five dollars a week for four weeks. Three hundred dollars moved into savings, while still having a treat every week.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. four coin stacks and a total. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Your tally
segments.narration: Add up your own transfers tonight, and write the real number at the top of your list. Whatever it is, that's money you chose to keep.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pencil and a sheet with a total. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The money
segments.narration: Where should it go? No emergency fund yet? Start one. Have one? Pay down a high-interest card, or open a sinking fund for something you'll buy later this year.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. three small jars with labels. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Look back
segments.narration: Look at your February list one more time. Cross off anything you don't want anymore. What's left, budget for it properly in February, with a number and a date.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a list with a few items crossed off. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Keep one
segments.narration: Pick the one rule that was easiest and keep it in February. For a lot of people it's the February list. Then check that list tomorrow: you may not want half of it anymore.
segments.on_screen_text: Keep 1 rule · check the February list
